_notes.vin_structure: 17 chars: pos1-3=WMI, pos4-8=VDS, pos9=check_digit, pos10=model_year, pos11=plant, pos12-17=serial
_notes.vds_note: Hyundai VDS encoding is among the most detailed and consistent of any manufacturer. All 6 VDS positions are used meaningfully. CRITICAL: positions 5 and 6 SWAPPED roles around MY2001. Pre-2001: pos5=body_style, pos6=trim_level. Post-2001: pos5=trim_level, pos6=body_type. Always check model year before decoding pos5/pos6.
_notes.gcc_note: Majority of UAE/GCC Hyundai vehicles carry KMH (Korean-built). India-sourced (MAL) vehicles: i10, i20, Creta — less common in GCC but increasing. MAL Creta has parts availability implications.
_notes.check_digit_note: KMH Korean-built GCC vehicles: pos9 may be check digit OR filler depending on exact market/build. US-market Hyundai (5NP/5NM) always NHTSA check digit.

KMH.notes: Primary Korean WMI; Sonata, Elantra, Santa Fe, Tucson, Ioniq

5NM.notes: Santa Fe, Tucson from Montgomery, AL

NLH.notes: i20, Tucson built in Izmit, Turkey

TMA.notes: i30, Tucson, ix35 from Nošovice plant

position_9._note: US-market (5NP/5NM): NHTSA check digit always. Korean-built GCC (KMH/KM8): may be check digit or manufacturer filler depending on exact build. Verify before flagging as invalid.

vds_era_detection._note: CRITICAL: Positions 5 and 6 swapped roles at MY2001. Use year from pos10 to select correct era table.

position_4_model_line._note: Position 4 = model line / platform code. Consistent across eras.
position_4_model_line.H: Tiburon / Genesis Coupe / i30 / Kona (2024+) / GV80

position_5_post2001_trim._note: POST-2001 (MY2003+): Position 5 = trim level. Use this for most modern Hyundai VINs.
position_5_post2001_trim.B: GL / Base Santa Fe (2001–2004) / Genesis G90 3.5T
position_5_post2001_trim.C: GLS / LX Santa Fe / SE Limited Azera / GLS Limited Entourage / 4.6L Genesis
position_5_post2001_trim.G: GL/GS Accent / GT Accent / GLS Accent (2005)
position_5_post2001_trim.M: GL Tiburon / GL Tucson / GL Sonata
position_5_post2001_trim.N: GLS/GT Elantra / GLS Accent / GT/SE Tiburon / LX Tucson

position_5_pre2001_body._note: PRE-2001 (up to MY2002): Position 5 = body style.

position_6_post2001_body._note: POST-2001: Position 6 = body type. Use this for most modern Hyundai VINs.

position_7_restraint._note: Position 7 = restraint system / GVWR. Consistent across eras.
position_7_restraint.6: Full airbag suite (front + side + curtain + knee)

position_8_engine._note: Position 8 = engine type. Stable and well-documented. Most common UAE: D (Theta II 2.0-2.4L), E (Lambda V6), T (Smartstream 1.5-1.6T).
position_8_engine.P: Ioniq electric motor 88–214 kW — Ioniq 5/6 BEV
